title: Deterministic sign-quotient exponent grid with orientation and dense-power root lifting

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 input T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_e=[s^e mod r]P0, uniform nonzero s, and every integer 2^20<=n<=2^32, set d=2^20, q=(r-1)/d, a=98748750602204457565883422358598783, b=98748750602204457565883422358598784, and N=a+b. The deterministic sign-quotient scalar-action grid followed by literal supplied-power binary root recovery succeeds exactly on 2ab of the q equally likely exponents, hence with success 2ab/q>=39/100. It has H(n)=0 and R(n)=N*(79650816+21135360+65536+256)+21*79650816+2^80+2^20*n scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents, with W(n)=R(n)/2000. At n=2^20, W<2^(3331/25). Repricing every instruction row by 6/5 still gives work below 2^(3331/25-1/10). Hard peak memory is at most 1536L+2^64<2^129 bytes, where L is the least power of two at least N. Canonicalization is stored-record maintenance only: every geometric-chain and root-candidate point action is charged completely, and every chain retains its original point. No multiplicative PH, unknown encoded-scalar exponentiation, random mapping, hash lookup or probabilistic collision premise is used.
